property.name: action.destructive_requires_name
property.description: Require explicit index names for destructive actions. Restart the service to apply changes. Additional native properties can be added in Advanced.

property.name: http.max_content_length
property.description: Maximum HTTP request body. Restart the service to apply changes. Additional native properties can be added in Advanced.

property.name: indices.memory.index_buffer_size
property.description: Heap fraction used for indexing buffers. Restart the service to apply changes. Additional native properties can be added in Advanced.

property.name: search.max_buckets
property.description: Maximum aggregation buckets per response. Restart the service to apply changes. Additional native properties can be added in Advanced.

property.name: cluster.max_shards_per_node
property.description: Maximum open shards per data node. Restart the service to apply changes. Additional native properties can be added in Advanced.
